statement: No Xbox One physical hardware, firmware-matched USB/Bluetooth descriptor, raw report, true host driver binding, SDL acceptance, rumble response or lifecycle observation was supplied or measured in this research session. The model-by-model Bluetooth and BLE firmware transition, descriptor changes and consumer mapping parity therefore remain unverified.

applicability.revision: all Xbox One first-party model and firmware variants under future owner reference review
applicability.scope: No experiments performed; source citations describe candidate consumers only and cannot close device-side gaps.
